rules.idPrefix: Suggested from the name: first letters of up to 3 words, upper case, plus '-'; made unique in the workspace (CA-, CA2-)
rules.fieldKey: slug of the name: lower case, a–z 0–9 and _, max 40, unique per sheet (due_date, due_date_2)
rules.csvTypes: per column: all ISO/locale dates → date; all numbers → number; all emails → email; all URLs → url; yes/no/true/false/1/0 → yesno; ≤ 12 distinct values and ≥ 2 repeats → dropdown (options created); otherwise text. The person confirms or changes each type before import. Max 10 000 rows, 100 columns, 10 MB.
